body:
DEMONSTRATED, for your queue (no ask tonight): the minter rejected and force-retired a good Codex lead because of an account nudge.
The seat was ref-2d84809e48a6f43e316f (codex 0.163.0, GPT-6-Astra max). Its boot turn completed at 23:53:43 (task_complete in its rollout). Codex then drew: 'Set up security for Daybreak mode / Set up Advanced Account Security with a hardware security key ... You can keep using Codex while you finish setup. 1. Set up security. Press a number to choose · esc to dismiss · type to continue'. The composer below it was live ('Ready').
The Observer read a dialog, so health was waiting. mint.wait_wakeable then refused at 23:58:41 with health=waiting composer=suggested working=False.
Evidence: bridge/archive/ref-2d84809e48a6f43e316f/scrollback-20261019T235841.txt and bridge/events.jsonl at 23:58:41-52.
The next seat, ref-4bc9297546b34b47e7f1, drew no nudge and minted READY. I refiled the 006 relief. Nothing answered the nudge.
